basis: Douglas Dynamics reported preliminary consolidated net sales of $82.5 million for the quarter ended March 31, 2023. That point estimate was below $97,470,950, the cutoff calculated as 95% of Q1 2022 reported net sales of $102,601,000. The May 1 GAAP table confirmed Q1 2023 net sales of $82,545,000, a 19.55% year-over-year decline.

coverage.detail: The October 31, 2022 Q3 release projected $600 million to $630 million in full-year 2022 net sales. Management expected headwinds to persist into 2023 but gave no Q1 2023 sales figure.
On the November 1 call, management reiterated the 2022 annual range and said it would provide 2023 guidance in February.
The February 20, 2023 Q4 release projected $620 million to $680 million in full-year 2023 net sales. It gave no separate Q1 sales range.
On February 21, an analyst explicitly asked how to model Q1. CFO Sarah Lauber said snowfall was affecting the business but gave no numeric bound for consolidated quarterly sales.

The February call mentioned the March work-truck show and Sidoti conference. No public quarter-specific sales estimate surfaced for either event. Sidoti's March 22–23 schedule listed Douglas Dynamics under one-on-one meetings only.
The intervening March 27 issuer release covered its fiscal 2022 ESG report and contained no Q1 2023 sales guidance.

On April 17 the preliminary consolidated results table showed Q1 2023 net sales of $82.5 million against $102.6 million for Q1 2022. The separate $620 million to $650 million range applied to full-year 2023.

The May 1 release's consolidated statements of loss reported net sales of $82,545,000 and $102,601,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022, respectively. Both amounts come from the same comparative GAAP line.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer's preliminary release carries an April 17, 2023 dateline. Item 2.02 of its Form 8-K independently confirms that Douglas Dynamics issued the release that day. [Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1287213/000143774923010452/plow20230413_8k.htm)
